title: 3. Operations & Complexity (Application)

### 3. Operations & Complexity (Application)

| Operation | Key-only | Dictionary / Map |
|---|---|---|
| Insert / Update | Insert Key（依重复 Key 策略） | put(k,v)：新 Key 插入，已有 Key 更新 Value |
| Search | Find Key | get(k) / containsKey(k) |
| Delete | Remove Key | remove(k) |
| Size | Key Count | size()（Entry Count） |

```java
Map<Integer, String> students = new HashMap<>();
students.put(13, "Alice");
students.get(13);          // "Alice"
students.put(13, "David"); // Update Value
students.remove(13);       // Delete
```


*Java API 补充：Map = Interface；HashMap = Class；以上只是一种 Dictionary 实现，不是所有 Hash Tables 的统一接口*

**Deletion · Tombstone only**：Never-used → Search 可停止；Deleted → Search 继续、Insert 可复用；NIL=-1 / DELETED=-2 只是某些整数 Key 实现的 Sentinel，不是通用定义
